## Report: PR 2 engine work (branch `claude/canon-2-recoil`, commit `87c9dc3`)

All of SPEC decisions 1–14 are done, along with the ledger, the test changes, the new checks and the item 7 engine comments. Every suite passes, and every result with the powers off is byte-identical. I committed `src/engine.js`, `test/powers.js` and the rebuilt `dist/index.html`; `src/data.js` didn't change. Nothing was pushed or merged. I didn't touch `test/powers-off-cases.js` or the fixtures.

**Tests (final run, one at a time):**
- `powers.js`: 144/144. That includes both powers-off fixture passes, 15,541 cases each. The full run takes 4 min 13 s on the shared CPUs; `--skip-off` takes about 35 s.
- `calibration.js`: all checks passed.
- `presence.js`: 383 checks, all passed.
- `sweep.js`: 7,776 contexts, 0 problems.
- `ladder.js`: 562/562.
- `shots.js`: not run, because the page is the next agent's job.

### What changed, per decision
1. **Where the push goes.** With `ownRecoil` on, the push back is reported as `recoilAbsorbed` instead of `toGround`. `ownAnchor` still returns `'bolted'`, so he stays planted.
2. **Own recoil wins over Bolted.** With both on, `recoilAbsorbed` is reported whatever the anchor. Bolted without the power behaves as before.
3. **His feet carry only the weights.** With the power on, the foot load in `throwOnce` is `(body.m + obj.m) g`. The same applies in `catchIt` and `relCatch`: `sinkRatio`/`sinkRatioRaw` are `(M + m) g`, which covers the catch's stop and the toss's catch. As a result, his throw can't break the ground with the power on. The ground hazard and the "break the ground" preset become `never` where only his recoil broke it (car at 45°, 10⁹ kg: 650,000 kg-force → never).
4. **The catcher is planted.** `relCatch` and `catchIt` use `ownAnchor(ctxC)`, and `uAfter` is 0 with the power on: no slip, no slide, never carried off. `leg` sets `recoilAbsorbedC` for caught, slams, wreckage and cant-hold-it. `fireballAt` is untouched.
5. **Stomp:** `recoilAbsorbed` = `push.pB`, pointing up. The blow is unchanged.
6. **Punch:** `recoilAbsorbed` = `push.pB`, with `returned: true` (net zero over the whole punch).
7. **Pull:** `recoilAbsorbed` = `ropeT × t10m`, bolted too. `MOVES.pull.shake` and `shakeWithPower` are removed; `RESTRAINT.shakeOff` is kept and now always returns false.
8. **Shove:** `recoilAbsorbed` = Jfeet. `toGroundB` has its own guard with the same condition as before, so in practice it only arises with Unbreakable footing alone.
9. **Wrestle throw:** works through `throwOnce`, so `t.r.recoilAbsorbed`. `landToGround` stays. I only added a comment.
10. **Arm pin:** with the winner's power on, the swing-time guard is dropped and J comes from the energy, `sqrt(E² + 2EMc²)/c`. `recoilAbsorbed` is added.
11. **Catch thrower and toss:** gated on `ownRecoil` first; this avoids `throwPushJ` silently recomputing a ground push. `recoilAbsorbedT` uses the exact throw's figure at full strength.
12. **`weakGround`:** the sideways test reads `ctx.anchor`, `downTaken` is added only where the cap applies, and the comment is rewritten.
13. **Collide, jump, sprint, clap, growth:** no code change. Comments only.
14. **Item 7 comments:** the header has the canon's momentum list and the figure contract. The `PASSENGER` comment and the four "exception to 'momentum is never absorbed'" comments now cite the canon's case. No "into the planet" recoil wording remains.

### New figures for the page (present only when the named power is on; never `{J:0}`)
- **`recoilAbsorbed { J, T, thetaDeg }`** on `throwObject` (and `throwPartner(...).r`), `stomp`, `punch`, `pull`, `shove` and `armWrestle` (pin).
  - J is in kg·m/s, ≥ 0, and Infinity when unbounded. T is the push's own time in seconds: `push.t`, t10m for the pull, or the swing time for the pin.
  - thetaDeg is the angle of *his* push above level, and the absorbed momentum points the opposite way:
    - throw: the throw angle; the push back points back along the throw line (backward, and downward for an upward throw)
    - punch and shove: 0; the push back points backward
    - pull: 0 is the way he walks; the push back points back toward the load
    - stomp and arm pin: −90; the push back points straight up
  - The punch's figure also carries `returned: true`.
- **`recoilAbsorbedT { J, T, thetaDeg }`** on `catchLeg` (the thrower) and `tossPartner` (thetaDeg 90).
- **`recoilAbsorbedC { J, T, angleDeg }`** on `catchLeg` and `tossPartner` (angleDeg 90). angleDeg is how steeply the object arrives, 0 = level. The absorbed momentum points along its arrival. T is the stroke time.
- **`toGround.downTaken`** (from `weakGround`) appears only where the cap applies.
- **Catcher with own recoil on:** `k.R` is Infinity, `slide` and `uAfter` are 0, `slips` and `carried` are false.

### Brief figures reproduced (3,000 kg bodies, defaults on; scratch `work/figures.js`)

| Figure | Old engine (main) | New engine (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| Least-disruptive car, 22,100 kg-force | `toGround` 22,000 kg·m/s (0.433 mm/s at 5 m) | `recoilAbsorbed` 22,000 kg·m/s at 45°, no `toGround`; landing 1.18 mm/s, from 'landing' |
| Same throw, all-out | push 41,500 kg·m/s, 1.99 mm/s; landing 6.44 mm/s; plaster 2.25 m | `recoilAbsorbed` 41,500 kg·m/s; landing 6.44 mm/s; plaster 2.25 m |
| Car all-out at 10¹² kg | ground 9.91e7 sideways + 9.90e7 supplied; plaster 3,600 m | `recoilAbsorbed` 1.40e8 back along 45°; nothing in the ground; shake null; plaster 0 |
| Shove | `toGround` 66,700 kg·m/s (2.29 mm/s) | `recoilAbsorbed` 66,700; Ollie 21.1 m/s, slides 36.7 m |
| Fastball 10 m at 10⁹ kg | thrower 3,250 kg·m/s (0.924 mm/s); catcher 1,310 (0.279 mm/s); slides 5.9 cm | `recoilAbsorbedT` 3,250 and `recoilAbsorbedC` 3,250; Ollie doesn't move |
| Catch at 10²⁰ kg | carried off at 4,000 km/s | not carried off; `recoilAbsorbedC` 1.22e10 kg·m/s |
| Pull a car, all-out | rope shaking 0.005 mm/s | no shaking; `recoilAbsorbed` 14,800 kg·m/s over 1.84 s |
| Toss 10 m | — | 42,000 / 42,000 kg·m/s (all-out 62,400 / 62,400) |
| Wrestle throw | — | `recoilAbsorbed` 63,100 kg·m/s |
| Arm pin, default dial vs half | no `toGround` | `toGround` = `recoilAbsorbed` 3,430 kg·m/s, 0.976 mm/s at 5 m |

**Consequences the page and README need to state:**
- The rattle preset rises where his push used to set it: semi on concrete at 0° goes 78,300 → 89,900 kg-force; bus on gravel at 0° goes 70,300 → 72,800.
- A bus thrown hard 10 m apart at the default dial now slams into Ollie's chest at 5.69 m/s; it used to be caught with him sliding 8.55 m.

### Mutation check (scratch `work/mutate.js`, mutants under `pr2/mutants/`)
All twelve mutants were killed against the final tests. These were the nine required (throw, stomp, pull, shove, wrestle throw, catch thrower, catcher, partner toss, arm pin) and three extras: the catcher unplanted, and the push back put back on his feet in the throw and the catch. The first run showed the wrestle-throw mutant was caught only by the ledger and the unbounded check, so I added a direct check for it.

### Things I decided that the spec didn't settle
- **T and direction:** T is the push's own duration, not stretched to a limb pulse. The direction is "his push's angle; the absorbed momentum points the opposite way", with `angleDeg` along the arrival for catches.
- **Unbounded catch:** with own recoil on, the `sinkRatioRaw` of `relCatch`'s unbounded branch is the weights only, not Infinity.
- **Arm pin, Unbreakable alone:** the slow-swing path still uses `vToMomentum`, so its numbers are unchanged.
- **Ledger, powers off:** where the engine reports no ground figure, the ledger works the planet's share out from the push itself, so those sums close by construction. The buckets and the reported figures are what it really checks.
- **Ledger, Collide bounce:** the knocked-back bounce with Unbreakable footing is left out of the sum (the ~1.1% footing over-count). A check holds that share under 2% of the hit instead.

### Not done; for the page agent or README
- **README:**
  - The Collide bounce over-count needs a Known limits entry for PR 4.
  - The decisions above need recording.
  - Copy that says presets never move is wrong for heavy loads.
- **`app.html`:**
  - 3315–3316 still recompute the pull's shaking.
  - `noShakeWhy` (3462) needs a branch for `move === 'pull'`.
  - The tile at 2842 would print "feet hold up to" Infinity.
  - The carried-off, slips and round-trip texts change.
  - 1552 no longer fires with own recoil on.
  - The stomp's "upper bound" caveat stays only for Bolted without the power.
- **`shots.js` checks expected to need updating (from the map):**
  - 480 (chip text)
  - 524–532 (the shove and catch plaster presets are now never with the defaults)
  - 199–201, only if the shakeOnly wording changes

The commit holds the rebuilt `dist/index.html` and `src/data.js`, the new record `rex-strength-lab/research/reviews/canon-3-round1.json`, and the README changes. I didn't touch `STATUS.md` or the PR body. The working tree is clean.

The record's lenses are copied word for word from `round1-raw.json` (checked by script), with an `outcome` added to each finding. Its counts are {findings 8, confirmed 7, refuted [physics-feel-vs-no-stress], no_verdict []}.

### Per finding

- **physics-catch-heat-unharmed and code-1 (major, same defect, fixed once and recorded under both).**
  - The Catch tab now uses the Throw tab's rule. A person is "hot" when Safe passenger is on, Things keep their form is off (`!a.kept`), some drag is left, and the air at the nose passes 1,200 K. I didn't use `heat.kind`, because the catch judges a person against steel.
  - Where the person is hot, the miss callout says: "Safe passenger takes back the landing's energy (…) and spreads its push through them, with no blast, but it doesn't cover the heating in flight (above), so the lab can't say they come down unharmed."
  - The palm tile now reads "(Safe passenger: spread through them; it doesn't cover the heating in flight)" instead of "no harm". The Game of catch card has the heat caveat.
  - **Check:** the shots.js round 1 block, using code-1's state (cLogD 1, logKg 8, air 0%, Things keep their form off, all-out). Reverts hot-callout, hot-tile and hot-card each fail it.
  - **Not fixed (older than this PR):** the catch's heat item still judges a person against steel's 1,538 °C, because OBJ_MATERIAL has no person entry.
- **physics-fast-landing-bearing.**
  - New engine helper `PASSENGER.landGround(o, v, surface)`. It gives the landing's average push: its momentum over landShake's own stop, which matches landShake exactly. It also gives what the ground bears: its bearing pressure times the person's 0.67 m² facing area, less their weight. On sand and gravel the bearing scales with a width of √0.67 m. It also returns whether the ground gives way, and the speed where it starts.
  - The momentum stays real and whole, with no new canon. Past that speed the page drops "no crater" and adds: "But past a landing of about 100 m/s, that push is more than the concrete slab bears, even spread over their whole facing area, so the ground gives way where they land (the lab doesn't size the hole, and its shaking figures are rough there)." On ice and steel, which have no shaking figures, the last clause is left out.
  - This text is on the Throw landing text, the Impact line and the Catch miss callout. The two cards, README decision 4 and Known limits give the thresholds.
  - **Checks:**
    - powers.js section 7 (new): the push equals landShake's average push; the threshold falls in the right place on every ground; the rounded speeds; no give-way at the default dial all-out; 545 times past it at 10^9.15 kg; granite bears it.
    - shots.js: the 10^9.15 kg check on the slab and on granite, the Catch miss at 155 m/s against 60 m/s, and the card's speeds.
    - Reverts bear-throw, bear-impact, bear-catch and card-bearing each fail a page check. bear-engine (`gives` always false) fails powers.js at 155/156 and two page checks.
- **physics-no-quake-claim.** The Impact line now reads "…so no blast where they land (the ground still gives way under its push: above). Its push still reaches the ground and shakes it (the effort box gives how far)." Where the ground bears the push it says "no crater or blast". **Check:** the shots.js very-fast-impact check forbids "quake". Revert quake fails it.
- **physics-hits-ground-exception (the skeptic's preferred fix).** A person with Safe passenger on who hits the ground with no air (`hitsGround.airK` not above 0) is now treated as a landing.
  - The verdict says the energy (32.7 PJ) is taken back, so no blast, and they come down unharmed. Its push (2.4 billion kg·m/s) still reaches the ground, and the ground gives way where they land.
  - There is no crater or quake line and no "where it hits the ground" blast block. The effort box's blast leaves the hit's energy out, and its harm wording changed. Below 100% absorbed, the fireball reading stays.
  - README decisions 5 and 7 and the card say so.
  - It moves no effort preset: in two states compared with 58c5374, his hand's own air sets every preset first. The new harm wording sits behind the hand's sound-barrier harm, so it never shows.
  - **Check:** the shots.js round 1 block at logKg 16, cLogD 4.5, with 50% absorbed as the control. Reverts hits-ground and hits-ground-block each fail it.

- **code-2 (the skeptic's check).** The Throw tab's drag chip and sentence in real air are now checked. The reviewer's two mutants, old-chip and old-drag-text, rebuilt on the fixed tree, each fail it.
- **physics-feel-vs-no-stress:** refuted, no change.

### Where the ground gives way under a person's landing (rounded on the page)

| Ground | Speed |
|---|---|
| Concrete slab (default) | 102 m/s |
| Asphalt | 102 m/s |
| Ice | 144 m/s |
| Steel deck | 5,570 m/s |
| Granite | 12,600 m/s |
| Loose sand | 19.8 m/s |
| Soft clay | 23.0 m/s |
| Stiff clay | 44.6 m/s |
| Dense gravel | 50.8 m/s |

At the default dial the person throw stays below the slab's threshold even all-out (81 m/s). An all-out 45° throw reaches it at a dial of about 145,000 kg.

### Mutants and tests

The build's six mutants, rebuilt on the fixed tree, each still fail:
- **Drag:** powers.js (5a and 7) and presence.js.
- **Landing energy:** powers.js and the page.
- **Landing momentum:** powers.js and the page's ceiling check.
- **Landing blast:** powers.js.
- **Migration skipped:** the page.
- **A mark-2 save read as a choice:** the page.

The full line, one test at a time, all passed:

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| calibration | 117 checks, all passed |
| presence | 383 checks, all passed |
| shots | 81 ok lines, 0 problems; the powers-off page comparison shows 16 states the same and 0 changed |
| powers | 160/160; part 1 has the 15,533 cases byte-identical and the 8 Safe-passenger cases identical through the shim |
| ladder | 562/562 |
| sweep | 7,776 contexts, 0 problems |

I also checked the new texts' states at 390 px in light and dark: no sideways scroll, broken text or page errors.

### Still open (in Known limits or the record)

- **Ice:** nothing counts a person breaking through ice, which has no shaking model. At a 10^9 kg dial the courtesy ceiling is set by the boom, at a landing of about 340 m/s. That is past ice's 144 m/s, so a person can break through the ice below the ceiling.
- **The hole isn't harm:** the lab doesn't count the hole where a person lands as harm. That matches every other thrown object, where only blast and shaking count. On sand and soft clay the ceiling's landing speed (26 to 28 m/s) is past the threshold; as with his own feet in soil, that isn't harm.
- **Pull request 5's shimmer:** a catch person's ground-hit energy isn't in `passengerLanding`. The shimmer should read it from `hitsGround.E`.

The change is pull request 4 of rex-strength-lab/BRIEF-canon.md, on branch claude/canon-4-contests (base claude/canon-3-passenger). Contests and the two Never knocked back switches (pull request #35, stacked on #34 Safe passenger and #33 their own recoil, both reviewed). Engine commit 0f27012, page commit 238f570. Diff: git diff claude/canon-3-passenger...claude/canon-4-contests. Collide's charger with They take their own recoil on is a body of unbounded mass (outcome 'carried': the one hit carried at his speed or sent off at 2v/(1+v^2/c^2); carry {v, vB, pGain, footJ, supplied, F, T, rockGives, tear, stop}; hitAbsorbed; meanIt; the charger stops himself at the end of the squash) or the 'paradox' where the one hit is held without limit (bolted on Unbreakable footing, or from above with Unbreakable footing / comic ground); the steady push uncapped by the pusher's footing (one-sided paradox and rock); the shoving match (pushMatchOwn: bothShoved with a motion model, walkOut, shovedOff, deadlock, paradox); Both at once (each shoved by the other's shove); arm wrestling built as reading B (each pad holds the other's press; a pin with the winner's power never breaks the table; standing his own footing doesn't cap his press; winnerSlides; draggedA/B; new unlimited outcomes); the fireball with the catcher's Never knocked back (knockAbsorbed, not moved, the motion energy taken back unless meant); the two switches noKnockback/oNoKnockback; Collide's bounce over-count fixed.
Read BRIEF-canon.md (item 4 (all of it) and the Answers Q1-Q5, Q12-Q15; "Rules for every item"; the Answers) and RUN-canon.md. The author's decisions are in the README section named below and the pull request; check whether each is justified by the canon, the physics and the code, and stated where the owner will see it. Do not report a decision as a defect merely because it departs from the brief's letter, unless it is wrong, unjustified or not stated.
DECISIONS AND CONTEXT FROM THE AUTHOR:
See rex-strength-lab/README.md, section 'Contests and the two Never knocked back switches (BRIEF-canon.md pull request 4)' (decisions 1-16, what moved, Known limits) and pull request #35's description (mcp__github__pull_request_read, owner RoscoeRackham, repo rex-strength-lab, pullNumber 35). Readings flagged in the brief to confirm in review: 'when he means it' = the blast presets; holding a partner up not counted as recoil; the shoving match's new outcome; the paradox cases; the arm-wrestling consequences (built as B, not the brief's A, with the reason in the README). The page author reported two engine gaps written up as Known limits: carriedHit's footJ = min(H, F) x T can equal pGain when the squash force is below the hold that gives (a slow charge into a Rex bolted on real rock, or from above on real ground), and pushMatchOwn doesn't check the rock around a single bolted wrestler's bolts against the other's finite push.

Build: cd rex-strength-lab && python3 build-data.py && node build.js (git status must stay clean: generated files match). Tests (4 shared CPUs: run one at a time, only what you need): node test/calibration.js, node test/presence.js, node test/shots.js (several minutes; writes dist/preview.html and shots/), node test/powers.js (4 min; --skip-off skips the 75 s powers-off part), node test/ladder.js, node test/sweep.js.   "title": "Collide 'carried': the energy the hit frees (Q, hitAbsorbed, Elocal) leaves out the work the hold does over the squash. Round 1's force fix was not carried through to the energy, so the energy is now inconsistent with the force F = squash + hold.",

- Bolted Rex on real rock, sprint: F 2.27 MN, Q 493,903 J. F·s = 713,003 J (1.44×).

The energy only balances with F·s. In every case the source's work F·v·T = Rex's KE + hold × during + F·s (default: 998,908 = 493,903 + 5,551 + 499,454).

- Reword the page line 'Rex’s motion energy as Ollie sees it' to 'plus the work his hold does over the squash'.

## Round 2 of PR 4: all 19 findings fixed and committed

All 19 confirmed findings are fixed in one commit, **f25f9b4**, on `claude/canon-4-contests`. It sits one commit ahead of origin and is not pushed; I didn't touch GitHub. The full test line passes. Every round 2 fix was reverted on its own in a scratch copy, and its check was seen failing. No background processes are left running.

**Files in the commit:** `rex-strength-lab/` `README.md`, `dist/index.html`, `src/app.html`, `src/data.js`, `src/engine.js`, `src/static-data.js`, `test/powers.js`, `test/shots.js`, and the new `research/reviews/canon-4-round2.json`. The record follows round 1's format: round 2, reviewed at f48a2c1, counts 19/19/[]/[], lenses verbatim, an `outcome` on each finding listing which revert failed which check.

**PR description:** `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-rex-strength-lab/be83ea46-0fb6-5f45-86e4-061daa8f7429/scratchpad/pr4/pr-body.md`. It has the new figures, decisions 8 (walk-out) and 9 (a pusher too weak to stand can't push), test counts, and both review rounds. `STATUS.md` was not touched; it still needs updating before anyone pushes.

### Per finding (revert IDs refer to `scratchpad/pr4/r2fix/js/revert2.py`)
- **physics-carried-hit-energy-omits-hold-work (major):** the hit now frees force × squash, including the hold's work. This is used for `out.Q`, `h.Q`, `hitAbsorbed.E` and the meant part of `Elocal`; the bounce still frees 0.
  - Covered by powers.js 8a (Q = F·s across the grid; at speeds below 1e-5 c, the source's work = the one hit's motion energy + hold × distance + Q, to 1e-9), plus 8c and 8l.
  - Covered by shots.js: the default sprint check and the round 2 "frees the force of the hit over the squash" check.
  - Reverts E1 and P1 fail.
- **physics-standing-pin-loser-elbow-force-unchecked (major):** standing in a pin, the force at the loser's elbow (`loserElbow`) is now checked against his feet (`loserSlides`) and against a bolted loser's rock tear.
  - Also fixed a defect found on the way: at unlimited strength against a finite press, the loser pad's load was ∞−∞ (NaN), so the table never broke and the page read "about unlimited". It is now unbounded.
  - Covered by powers.js 8i (1,440 standing pins: 920 sliding, 250 bolted on real rock) and the shots.js round 2 elbow check.
  - Reverts E2, E3, P12, P18 and P19 fail.
- **physics-walkout-push-contradicts-motion (major):** as decided, `walkPush = Hl + m_l·a` (35.3 kN; he could push 890 kN), and `recoilAbsorbed = m_l v + Hl t` (38,300 kg·m/s). Tile, chip, bars, item and README decision 8 updated.
  - Covered by powers.js 8g (walkPush, push back, momentum adds up) and the shots.js round 2 walk-out check.
  - Reverts E5, P6 and P6b fail.
- **copy-arm-one-bolted-unlimited-no-answer (major):** where one wrestler is held without limit, the result is now a one-sided paradox: the press into him has no answer, and his own press flings the other off (his rock tears if he is bolted).
  - Covered by powers.js 8i and the shots.js round 2 check. Reverts E4 and P13 fail.
- **copy-shoving-match-stroke-formula (major):** text and math now describe the model as built: each moves about half the stroke when both are shoved, the loser moves all of it when one is shoved off, and past 1% of light speed he leaves as a fireball.
  - Covered by shots.js round 2. Revert P7 fails.
- **physics-slide-harm-ignores-stroke = copy-push-distance-left-out-of-slide-harm** (fixed once, recorded under both): `apart()` returns xA and xB, and the harm counts where each one ends up. The Two-player effort card now says so.
  - Covered by powers.js 8g and three shots checks. Reverts E6, P16, P17 and P21 fail.
- **physics-steady-push-real-muscle-unlabelled:** took the minimal fix, which the skeptic offered first. In real-muscle mode the drive's speed is labelled an upper bound (`drive.realUpper`), so the steady push stays equal to the shoving match's shove-off.
  - Covered by powers.js 8f and shots.js. Reverts E8 and P4 fail.
- **physics-carried-motion-air-below-1pct-c:** new `carry.Eair` (his motion energy less his footing's share over the slide) is counted as real when he leaves faster than sound. Item, blast label and harm line added.
  - Covered by powers.js 8c and shots.js. Reverts E9, P3 and P20 fail.
- **physics-steady-push-lying-pusher:** a pusher too weak to stand pushes 0 (`cantStand`), matching the shoving match's rule (threshold 2,140 kg-force).
  - Covered by powers.js 8f and shots.js. Reverts E7 and P5 fail.
- **duo-noanswer-follows-top:** the no-answer caveat now follows any effort the search probed (`p.noAnswerIn`), not only all-out.
  - Covered by shots.js round 2. Revert P11 fails.
- **duo-both-at-once-bolts-pulse:** Both at once now counts the stalled shove's push through the bolts (`toGroundA`/`toGroundB`): 55,800 kg·m/s with Ollie bolted at 90.7 t. Chip and item added.
  - Covered by powers.js 8h and shots.js. Reverts E10 and P10 fail.
- **duo-r2-mutant-survivors:** new shots.js check. Both surviving mutants of the build's page code (M-N9, M-N11) now fail it.
- **copy-empty-bar-caption:** unlimited rows are now listed in the chart. Covered by shots.js; revert P9 fails.
- **copy-bolted-winner-shake-not-shown:** chip and item added; "only" removed. Covered by shots.js; revert P8 fails.
- **copy-source-supplied-two-figures:** three figures throughout the view. Covered by shots.js; revert P2 fails.
- **copy-catch-switches-differ:** the switch wording now follows the setting, and the return leg gets its own blast block. Covered by shots.js; reverts P14 and P15 fail.
- **duo-test-claims-stale = copy-stale-pin-stays-on-table** (fixed once): documentation only (README Tests paragraph, PR body, a shots.js comment). No test covers documentation.

**Done: commit `3cb9f60` on `claude/canon-5-shimmer`** (on `1a3b91b`; not pushed). It holds the engine, the tests and a rebuilt `dist/index.html`. `data.js` didn't change. The page stage's guide is `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-rex-strength-lab/be83ea46-0fb6-5f45-86e4-061daa8f7429/scratchpad/pr5/engine-report.md`: the exact call for each tab, every figure, the decisions and the mutant table.

**Tests:** `calibration.js` all passed; `presence.js` 383 passed; `powers.js` 210/210 (29 new; part 1 and its fixture unchanged); `ladder.js` 578/578 (16 new). `shots.js` and `sweep.js` were not run, as instructed.

**API**
- `P.RESTRAINT.takenBack(move, r, o)` returns `{ E, unbounded, parts, by }` in joules.
  - `parts` has nine keys, always present: `drag`, `footing`, `soft`, `silent`, `hit`, `stop`, `passenger`, `catch`, `growth`.
  - `by` is `{ rex, ollie }`, each `{ E, unbounded, parts }`. The glow on Rex's art should use `by.rex.E`.
  - Solo moves (`throw`, `jump`, `stomp`, `punch`, `clap`, `weight`): pass the run's context, plus `obj` and `angle` for a throw, or `growE` for Weight.
  - Two-player moves (`wrestleThrow`, `catch` with `{a, b}`, `toss`, `collide`): pass `{ A, B, whoA }`, plus `angle` or `obj`, and `miss` for the what-if.
  - Walk, Lift, Sprint, Pull, Arm wrestle, the other Wrestle moves and the steady push always return 0.
  - An unlimited run gives `E = Infinity` with `unbounded: true`. No part is ever NaN, and an unknown move throws.
  - No result, `reach()`, `plan()` or `planNow()` gains a key, and nothing is named `shimmer`.
- `EnergyLadder.glow(J, refs)` returns `{ none, unbounded, level, strength, word, rough, text, held, steps, floor, flicker, flare }`.
  - The three anchors are found by key; a ladder missing one throws.
  - The level is on a log scale and held at 1 above the flare. The glow strength is 0 at the floor and 1 at the flare.
  - Words: "too faint to see", then "a faint flicker" up to a car crash, then the nearest named step.

**Figures against the spec**
- Car 30 m, least disruptive (22,100 kg-force): 35.0 kJ ✓. All-out: 0.27 MJ ✓. Both a faint flicker.
- Stomp all-out: 103 kJ (0.10 MJ) ✓.
- Stomp at 10⁹ kg: 1.14 GJ ✓, level 0.19 ✓. **The word differs:** the spec says "nearest step a flicker", but by its own nearest-step rule 0.186 is nearest the quarter step, so it reads "about a faint glow". The other rule (the step at or below) would make 135 TJ "faint glow" instead of the spec's "about a glow".
- Ollie charges Rex at 0.1% of light speed: Rex takes in 135 TJ, level 0.47, "about a glow" ✓. **The tally adds Ollie's own stop** (another 135 TJ, decision 3), so the total is 270 TJ.
- Person thrown 30 m, least disruptive: 14.6 kJ ✓.
- The step energies (1.62 × 10¹⁰, 5.08 × 10¹⁴ and 1.59 × 10¹⁹ J) and their three wordings match the spec exactly.

**Decisions the spec didn't settle** (for the owner; details in the report)
1. **The drag is counted once.** Where an arrival is also taken back (a catch, a person's landing, a hit, a crater-sized landing on the partner's footing), the drag part is only what exceeds it. Otherwise the same joules would count twice. This is why the person figure comes out at 14.6 kJ.
   - For review: when the object lands for real, the "drag taken back" is energy the air didn't get, not energy that left the world. The car lands with it.
2. **New footing part:** the Wrestle throw's partner landing, where real ground would take a crater, on his own Unbreakable footing.
3. **New `stop` part:** in Collide the charger stops himself, and the engine sends his motion energy (`carry.stop.E`) to his source. Dropping it is one line.
4. **Whose hit:** the hit's freed energy goes to the one hit, read from canon's list of incoming hits.
5. **Rough steps:** "roughly" for the flare and the three-quarter step, by the ladder's own rule. Read through the flare's 33× uncertainty, all three middle steps would be rough instead, which would need a data change.
6. **The faint flicker is a band** (canon: below a car crash), not a step.
7. **The game of catch is a round trip.** Leg a's catch is Ollie's, the return leg's is Rex's.
8. **At an unlimited (light-speed) charge the tally takes nothing back.** That is pull request 4's "unstoppable" behaviour, unchanged here.

**For the page stage**
- Two existing texts now contradict the tally: the catch's "ends up as heat in his plush", and "the lab doesn't draw yet".
- STATUS.md needs Waiting-on question 3 (does Ollie show absorption?), and the README needs this pull request's section. Neither was in this stage.

Every finding must be REPRODUCED: give the exact input or place, what the page or code does (quote it, or your script's output), what is correct and why (with numbers), and a minimal fix. Round 1 (canon-5-round1.json), at 1d92534: 11 findings (13 reports, two pairs merged), 9 confirmed and fixed in f6d20c3, 2 refuted (design-flicker-word-vs-car-crash: canon's band; copy-6: the card's 'roughly'). FIRST, round 1's fixes in your lens (canon-5-round1.json): design-unbounded-no-physical-answer (the unbounded tile's wording) and the page-test additions for the glow (--glow as the square root of the strength). Revert each fix on its own in a scratch copy, rebuild, run its covering check (node test/shots.js --pr5 in the copy) and confirm it FAILS; restore and confirm it passes. Then the lens: LENS: DESIGN AND ACCESSIBILITY (RUN-canon.md, pull request 5: 'the glow's placement on dino.jpg and art-unstoppable.jpg at both widths and in both themes, and the tile read by screen readers'). Render the page at 390 and 1280 px, light and dark, with Playwright, and LOOK at crops of both pictures (header dino.jpg and the Collide tab's art-unstoppable.jpg) with the glow at 0, at a middling level and at full (pick runs from the engine report and the README: a car throw, a 10^9 kg stomp, Ollie's charge at 0.1% of light speed, a growth what-if past the flare). Check: the glow sits on his eyes, feather tips and mouth (measure: compare the layer's spots with the features on the marked images in scratchpad/understand345/shimmer/marked-*.png and in your own crops), never on the Collide caption or the background spires, never spills outside the picture (390 px: the header image at the 16 px gutter), causes no layout shift or sideways scroll, and the art is not altered (assets/ files byte-identical; the image itself not filtered or recoloured). The glow's strength follows the level (0 draws nothing; monotone; held at the flare). Reduced motion (emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): no animation anywhere in the glow. Accessibility: the Shimmer tile is in the accessibility tree with its word, energy and comparison (Playwright accessibility snapshot or aria tree), same markup as the other tiles; the glow layers are aria-hidden and pointer-events none and not focusable; contrast of the tile's text in both themes; the tile sits at the END of each tab's tile row (never between an energy tile and its 'Compared with'), on every tab where the tally is above 0 (Throw, Jump, Stomp, Punch, Clap, the Wrestle throw, the game of catch, the partner toss, Collide, Weight's what-if box) and on none where it is 0 (every relevant power off; the Weight what-if is the recorded exception). Which picture follows which run: the header follows the solo bay's current tab and only Rex's take; the Collide picture follows the Collide run, Rex's take. Also: switching tabs, themes and widths, loading a saved page, and the duo bay opening and closing: the glow never sticks from an earlier run. Look for anything a reader would find broken or confusing.

Under verified_ok, list what you checked and found correct (with the numbers). Prefix finding ids with "design-".

args.report:
All 9 round-2 findings are fixed, every revert and mutant check came out as required, and the full Rex lab test line passes. The work is committed on `claude/canon-5-shimmer` as **f43e3fb**. Nothing was pushed, merged or opened, and the image files are unchanged.

**Per finding** (each fix was reverted on its own in a scratch copy, rebuilt, and its check seen failing; restored, everything passes; records in scratchpad pr5/r2fix/revert2-results.json):

1. **design-crest-tips-off-feathers.** I measured all eleven tips from dino.jpg rather than copying the skeptic's six (script pr5/r2fix/js/tips.py). It marks tan or orange pixels, finds each tip's end, and puts the spot at the centroid of tan pixels within 9 px of that end.
   - Changes are in `ART_GLOW` and the test's own copy, `FEAT.hero`.
   - New check `crest-tips` reads assets/dino.jpg itself and requires every spot, both the page's and the test's, to sit on crest-coloured pixels.
   - `glow-features` now requires every tip to brighten by at least 6 (it was 70% of them) and has the skeptic's narrow control on the background beside the crest top.
   - Revert: page coordinates alone, and page plus test copy, each fail `crest-tips` and `glow-features`.
2. **copy-1.** The sentence now reads "counts their power's P share of what real air would take…: X", so it is true whether or not the blast's figure is the same. `share-copy` adds a supersonic baseball at 50% and checks that "a different figure" never appears. Revert fails `share-copy`.
3. **copy-2.** The Their powers card and README Known limits now say "three things their own moves free…", and list what belongs to Silent strike and Unbreakable footing instead. Revert fails `recoil-card`, and the old README fails the docs check (docs2.py).
4. **copy-3.** The shimmer card says "the share their power takes back (the Air resistance absorbed slider) of what real air would have taken". The PR body, the README Known limits and owner item 1 say the same. Revert fails `shimmer-card`, and the old texts fail docs2.py.
5. **copy-4.** The upper-bound label is added to the Wrestle throw and the partner toss. I also added it to the game of catch, which had the same unlabelled upper bound; I found that while fixing this. New check `fast-label`. Each of the three labels, reverted, fails it.
6. **code-1.** An arm-wrestling pin that real ground would crater is now a footing part held by Unbreakable footing. The page gets the tile and a sentence saying whose take it is. There is no glow, because no two-player run except Collide's charge has one.
   - Example: Rex at 10⁹ kg pinning Ollie at 10⁸ kg takes in 2.01 GJ, about a faint glow (it was nothing before).
   - Checks: engine section 9j code-1 and a new page check `arm`.
   - Reverts: the engine part fails 9j, the page parts fail `arm`, the card fails `shimmer-card`.
7. **code-2.** The tiny-residue rounding fix and the matching kinetic-energy convention for catches. Three fast legs had false drag parts (0.00049 J, 15.2 MJ and 544 kJ beside each catch); each is now 0. The check 9j code-2 covers 74 legs including 14 past 1% of c, plus unlimited-strength catches. Both reverts fail 9j code-2.
8. **code-3.** Two new 9j checks: a tank at 10^16.5 kg (the cap at what was thrown) and a 10 m tall Ollie (the leg that lands short of his hands). This is test-only. The skeptics' mutA, mutB and both together each fail them. With section 9 as it was at f6d20c3, they pass.
9. **code-4.** New check `duo-effort` reads the two-player slider's own effort. `duo-tiles` and `duo-who` gained rows: Collide with Rex charging, Ollie throwing in the Wrestle throw, and a lob round trip. P03, P04, both P13 variants and P21 all fail now.
   - Departure: the page has only one partner-toss thrower (Rex), so I read "the toss with each thrower" as Collide's two chargers, which is the P04 case. P08 already covers the toss.

**New crest-tip coordinates:** (0.327, 0.046), (0.359, 0.025), (0.395, 0.015), (0.432, 0.031), (0.473, 0.055), (0.516, 0.097), (0.538, 0.135), (0.570, 0.181), (0.598, 0.221), (0.628, 0.266), (0.653, 0.298).
- At full strength each glow now covers 5–17% backdrop (the old first six covered 40–95%).
- Header tips brighten by +50.6 on average at 1280 px (each at least +35) and +45.5 at 390 px (each at least +36). The control beside the crest reads 0.0.
- I looked at crops at 390 and 1280 px, light and dark, at no glow, a faint glow and full glow: the glows sit on the feathers. I also looked at the changed Arm, label and share views in all four modes: no sideways scroll, no page errors.

**Full test line (4-CPU sandbox, one test at a time, all pass):**

| Test | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| build-data.py, build.js | ok | 1 s each |
| calibration.js | all checks passed | 109 s |
| presence.js | 383 checks | 45 s |
| shots.js | 85 checks, no problems | 853 s |
| powers.js | 221/221 (part 1 matches; fixture unchanged and not regenerated) | 227 s |
| ladder.js | 579/579 | 1 s |
| sweep.js | 7,776 contexts, 0 problems | 524 s |

The `--pr5` block took 71.7 s and 71.2 s before the fixes and 79.4, 76.4 and 79.4 s after; it now has 23 checks, up from 19.

**Mutants:** I re-ran 232 from round 2's reviewers and skeptics, round 1, the engine stage and the page stage; 12 of their patterns had to be followed into code that later rounds moved.
- 218 fail their own test.
- 2 fail a different test in the line: N25 fails `duo-who`, and mutA plus mutB together fail section 9j.
- 12 are equivalent:
  - N02 and N05: each figure exists only with its power on.
  - N04: exactly Mach 1, which no dial setting lands on.
  - N15: those parts exist only in a carried hit.
  - N28: no part's input is ever negative.
  - N30: I searched 2,649 legs flown at full drag and none timed out.
  - N43 and round 1's EM-11: a flight past 1% of c never lands.
  - EM-09: `hitsGround.kept` is set exactly when `hitsGround.own` is.
  - The engine stage's nan-guard: the other NaN guard covers it.
  - L13 and L15: each gives the same result either way.
- Three survivors the reviewers left are now killed:
  - N29: the code lens called it equivalent, but it shows a false unbounded drag part at unlimited strength.
  - L01: a new exact-tie check in test/ladder.js.
  - P21: killed by the lob row.

**Close-out:** canon-5-round2.json is written (verified_ok kept as given; each finding has its outcome with the fix, the check and the revert result). The README PR 5 section and general Test section are updated, and the owner's list of 12 matches the PR body's (checked with docs2.py). scratchpad/pr5/pr-body.md is updated; the live #36 description still needs it pasted in. STATUS.md is updated as instructed. No background processes of mine remain (checked with `ps aux`).

**Decisions for the owner:**
- Decision 25, a new reading: a pin's slam is the **winner's** take, because his swing drives it. The alternatives are the loser's, or shared. It is item 12 on the owner's list.
- A pin past 1% of c, or below 2 km/s, counts nothing, because the engine has no crater model there. This is recorded in Known limits.
- I left the Collide picture's last spike glow (0.619, 0.090) where it was. Its spike's sunlit end is nearly white, so a colour test can't tell spike from sky there; the brightness check still covers it.
